description:
At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager for NetBox Core. Core is the open source foundation that NetBox Cloud, NetBox Enterprise, and our downstream products are built on. The team ships open source releases on a regular cadence and also works on capabilities like Branching, Changes, and Custom Objects. This is a technical, hands-on product management role. You'll shape how the NetBox data model and capabilities expand, and you'll run the operational side of the team.

What you'll do

  • Own intake and triage of requests coming into the Core team from Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Support - while also remaining abreast of interactions with our large open source community

  • Treat NetBox Cloud, NetBox Enterprise, and downstream application teams as first-class customers of Core, make sure they know what's landing and when, and that their needs show up in planning

  • Run the product side of the team's sprint ceremonies such as backlog grooming planning, refinement, reviews

  • Make the day-to-day decisions that inevitably come up mid-cycle: scope tradeoffs, edge cases, security questions, behavior questions, what's good enough to ship

  • Make sure open source releases are planned and communicated well, release notes, community expectations, and how a change lands for practitioners

  • Triage GitHub issues and engage with contributors alongside the engineering team

  • Demo work in progress, including features that are experimental, to internal teams and customers to get feedback early

  • Run the research that feeds Core direction, customer and partner calls, competitive and community signal, usage patterns

  • Support strategic initiatives with discovery, requirements, and customer validation, working with the VP Product and CPO who set direction

  • Shape how the NetBox data model graph and capabilities expands, including backward compatibility, deprecation, and how a change ripples into integrations, automations, and customer extensions

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years of product management experience in B2B software, with at least 2 years on infrastructure, developer tools, or other deeply technical products

  • Hands-on technical ability. You can stand up a NetBox instance, install and configure plugins, work through the API, and demo something that isn't finished yet without getting lost

  • Comfortable in a codebase: you can read a pull request, follow a technical design doc, and hold a real conversation with engineers about implementation tradeoffs

  • Strong execution habits. You run sprint ceremonies well, keep a backlog clean, make decisions quickly when they're yours to make, and know when to escalate

  • Solid API and data model instincts. You understand REST and GraphQL, versioning, and backward compatibility, and you know a schema change is a contract with everyone building on top of it

  • Product judgment on platform decisions. You've shaped a data model, schema, or API surface before, and you can make the case for a change with customer evidence and hold it with engineers

  • Clear communicator across audiences. you can explain an upcoming feature to an engineer, a CSM, and a customer, and adjust for each

  • Comfortable building structure where there isn't much yet

Bonus qualifications

  • Experience with open source products or communities — issue triage, contributor dynamics, and release communication for an audience you don't control

  • Hands-on experience as a network engineer, DevOps engineer, or software engineer

  • Familiarity with network infrastructure concepts — devices, interfaces, IP management, circuit management, or similar domains

If you meet most of this and the work excites you, we'd like to hear from you.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
